segments.text:
V. 12.
Our Father Iacob—So they fancied he was; whereas they were, in Truth, a Mixture of many Nations, placed there by the King of Aſſyria, in the room of the Iſraelites whom he had carried away captive. (2 Kings xvii. 24.) Who gave us the well—In Joſeph, their ſuppoſed Forefather: And drank thereof—So even he had no better Water than this.
